vulnerability.name: USN-8855-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that GStreamer Bad Plugins incorrectly validated the size of multi-channel audio blocks. An attacker could possibly use this  issue with a specially crafted WAV file to cause the program to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: GStreamer Bad Plugins could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it opened a specially crafted file.
